steps.before: .screen == "CHARACTER_SELECT" and .character_select.is_multiplayer == false and any(.character_select.characters[]; .character_id == "KARAKURIZA-DIRECTOR" and .is_locked == false)

steps.after: ([.run.deck[]?.card_id] | group_by(.) | map({key: .[0], value: length}) | from_entries) == {"KARAKURIZA-STRIKE":4,"KARAKURIZA-DEFEND":4,"KARAKURIZA-THREAD_FEED":1,"KARAKURIZA-PUPPET_STRIKE":1} and any(.run.relics[]?; .relic_id == "KARAKURIZA-THREE_ACT_MECHANISM")
